title: B-Roll: Elephant Seals on the Channel Islands
licence: Public domain: work of a U.S. federal agency (NOAA), 17 U.S.C. 105. Gallery title card: "All footage courtesy of the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA), a federal agency of the U.S. Department of Commerce. Please credit 'NOAA Fisheries'"
description: Footage of elephant seals in the wild in the Channel Islands National Marine Sanctuary. Footage includes general rookery behavior, male sparring, courting, mating, and nursing on San Miguel Island.
